prompt.zh-TW: 飯店付清了上個月欠晴川花坊的 {{money:e1.amount}}。這筆收款之後，下面四個數字各會怎麼變？
prompt.en: The hotel pays the {{money:e1.amount}} it owed Clearwater Florist from last month. After this collection, how does each of the four figures below change?

explanation.zh-TW: 現金增加 {{money:e1.amount}}、應收帳款減少同樣的金額；營業收入不變，因為上個月就認列過了。收到的錢來自本業，所以營業活動的現金流量增加。
explanation.en: Cash rises by {{money:e1.amount}} and trade receivables fall by the same amount; revenue is unchanged because it was recognised last month. The cash comes from the core business, so operating cash flow rises.

hint.zh-TW: 賒銷時已經認列過收入了嗎？
hint.en: Was the revenue already recognised at the time of the credit sale?
